passwordRecovery.ownerOnly: For installations from source, the instance owner can reset their password from the terminal on the machine running Lumiverse.
passwordRecovery.openTerminal: Open a terminal on that machine and go to your Lumiverse installation folder (the folder containing package.json and data/).
passwordRecovery.newPassword: Follow the prompts to enter and confirm a new password of at least 8 characters.
passwordRecovery.signIn: Return to this page and sign in with the owner's username and new password. Existing sessions for that account will be signed out.
passwordRecovery.otherAccounts: If you are not the instance owner or do not have terminal access, contact your administrator to reset your password. For Docker or hosted instances, contact the server operator for recovery help. For single sign-on, reset your password with your sign-in provider.
